claim_levels.factual_same_function: The original rook/d6 occupation is realized later with queen recovery instead of knight recovery. This is a changed implementation of a local d6 occupation function.
claim_levels.useful_current_choice: The current native owned choice comparison supports Qd3 rather than immediate Rd6 after Nb1/Nc7. It does not price the late Rd6 separately.
claim_levels.strongest_defense_constraint: At the recorded late arrival the only legal Black capture of that rook is Qxd6; White only Qb4xd6 answers it, with no next immediate Black recapture of that queen. Actual ...Qc8 declines that capture. Best overall defense remains untested at this exact late prefix.
claim_levels.original_root_judgment: No sole explanation of Nc4/Nb1 or earlier Rfd1 numeric judgment is established. Nb1 has a useful different continuation; that alone neither erases its timing concession nor proves it inferior.
claim_levels.whole_criteria: Original full four-case0/4 and eight-source0/8 human readings remain unchanged. This research identifies a missing semantic operation, not a new passing output.

necessary_actual_prices.early_unprotected_Rd6: After Nb1/Nc7, Qxd6 legally takes the original d1 rook and no immediate White recapture is legal.
necessary_actual_prices.provider_replacement_exchange: Original WhiteNd2 (gameNb1) is captured, and original WhiteQueen captures the Black knight. The knight is not quietly retained as the late provider.
necessary_actual_prices.rook_file_exchange: White originalRa1 captures original BlackRd8 (gameRa8), then original BlackRf8 (gameRh8) captures that WhiteRa1. This removes the Black rook that could otherwise recapture a queen on d6 from d8.
necessary_actual_prices.late_conditional_price: Rook5 loss versus BlackQueen9 loss if Black chooses Qxd6 Qxd6; this is a conditional nominal ledger, not the actual ...Qc8 line or a numerical utility proof.
necessary_actual_prices.observed_outcome: Actual ...Qc8 leaves the rook, and Rxb6 captures the original BlackPb6 (gamePa7). Do not replace actual refusal with the hypothetical queen trade.
necessary_actual_prices.default_scope: These exchanges belong to the particular long realization. Do not force all of them into a short ordinary-purpose answer unless the answer claims this realization/price or omits a required selected loss.

falsifiers.name: same good current choice, different realized plan
falsifiers.source: Native work6 Qd3(+121) uses Ra7/Rc7 and has no Rd6; work7 Qd3(+118) reaches lateRd6.
falsifiers.falsifies: A valuable Qd3 must follow this exact late rook/PV route.
falsifiers.does_not_falsify: Qd3 may preserve several useful plans; same local purpose can change implementation.

falsifiers.name: controller without current user access
falsifiers.exact_actual_prefix: Nb1 Nc7 Qd3 c4; also later Qd2 phases
falsifiers.fact: Queen controls d6 but blocks the d1 rook; Rd6 is illegal.
falsifiers.falsifies: Support(d6) alone means the rook use is presently available.
falsifiers.does_not_falsify: The plan can reopen the route later.

falsifiers.name: legal user without recovery
falsifiers.fact: Rd6 remains legal; Nc5 still blocks Qb4xd6, so ...Qxd6 has no immediate White recapture.
falsifiers.falsifies: Different Black replies can preserve the old late proof merely because the rook move is legal.
falsifiers.scope: Legal constructed counter, not a best-defense or objective-sacrifice evaluation.

falsifiers.name: legal queen recovery with consequential recapture
falsifiers.fact: After the legal Rd6, both ...Rxd6 and ...Qxd6 are legal. Qb4xd6 is available but the other Black queen/rook can then capture it.
falsifiers.falsifies: An immediate queen recapture by itself makes a rook occupation adequately protected or useful.
falsifiers.scope: Complete immediate capture/recapture inventory; no engine value claim.

generic_predicates.definition: At each realization, canonically track the original friendly user and the same purpose-relevant action/destination. Do not require the original provider to survive.
The exact actor/action is in the complete legal catalogue at the decision position, including current blockers, turn, check, capture and promotion.
For every legal opposing capture of that user after arrival, enumerate every immediate legal friendly recapture with its current provider identity.

Include opposing recaptures/check responses that change the selected recovery price, and retain prior losses needed for that price. Support count or material face values alone do not certify adequacy.

An exact current provider may replace a lost/moved provider only if the relevant transaction stays adequate under the current opposing resources; this must be separately evidenced, never copied from the old provider.

A product-valued local action owns its current decision comparison against an adequate alternative and a completed required opponent resistance survey at the same prefix/profile/depth. A longer earlier PV is not that receipt.
To attribute usefulness to the original choice, compare matched reply/action scopes or otherwise own the original relevant defense families; distinguish a contributing aspect from exclusive cause.

smallest_integration_proposal.factual_first: Retain a function key based on exact original user plus action/destination/purpose. Attach per-realization provider/route/price witnesses instead of a permanent original-provider event chain. Label this as the later observed realization.
smallest_integration_proposal.candidate_discovery: An owned alternative current choice may contain the same original user/action later. Read its current canonical access and all recovery prices; admit only a factual changed-provider unit until that exact later decision has its own value evidence.
smallest_integration_proposal.value_admission: If proposing that later action as useful, issue the same current-prefix action-versus-strongest-other comparison and its owned first-opponent full pool, retaining important prices across tied replies. This is a finite missing obligation, not a timer/PV-label shortcut.
smallest_integration_proposal.main_answer_organization: The immediate Nb1/Nc7 choice can honestly say Qd3 is preferable to the refuted direct rook entry; the later queen-supported Rd6 is a conditional explanatory detail. A changed good plan may satisfy a purpose answer without claiming whole score causality.
smallest_integration_proposal.avoid: Do not reinterpret the existing root-specific knight-control condition as proof of queen support after the knight is captured. Do not reuse the earlier Qd3 score as a lateRd6 receipt, require the exact ...Ne6 PV event, or import native studies as product evidence.

SG42_comparison.source_pages: Think Like a Super-GM Reading Edition419,422–426; already directly studied and frozen in human-criteria-and-scenes.
SG42_comparison.same_principle: After ...Rd3 the original Re3 leaves its e2 duty, but the other original Re8 can answer the same WhiteRe1xe2 attempt. The e2 constraint can survive a provider change.
SG42_comparison.difference: SG42 explicitly checks no immediate White recapture after the replacement rook recovery. NB1 late queen support similarly needs its current exact transaction, but the open-d-file counterexample shows that a subsequent different Black capturer can invalidate a short price story.
SG42_comparison.purpose_only: SG42 has several good conversion plans; a concrete Rd3 pressure/conversion purpose can be sufficient. A full unique root ranking or a forced c3 win requires more. The same separation applies to Qd3/LateRd6 here.
